answer: Newcomers must post 100 ivory tokens as collateral to join. Wharf agents verify registration by inspecting the deposit. On failure, agents slash 5 tokens per hour until the deposit is insufficient. Mass cloning results in a net loss for the attacker. If 1000 clones are made, each with 1 token, the cost of 1000 tokens to clone is 1001 due to the increasing tide of demand, pushing the price up by 1 token for each seat, leading to a total cost of 1001 tokens for 1001 seats, resulting in a loss of 1 token per clone.
